author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Garden fork and trowel side by side as in the reference: a U-shaped fork with a middle tine running into the neck, and a trowel with a pointed blade over a flat base (was a diamond tip); both hang from necks into capsule handles. Lucide shovel/trowel construction (blade + neck + grip).
omissions: Handles are 8-wide capsules (the reference's are wider) so the heads and handles keep 8 apart; the fork's tines are 6 long.
